real_run.latency_gate_note: Reusable local actions stayed below the 1.5 s hard maximum. The observed p95 was 1.251 s, 251 ms above the 1.0 s target; this remains an explicit follow-up optimization rather than a hidden green claim.

changes: Deterministic final route guard for media/time/reminder/browser intents.
Verified compound command batches; no silent first-clause completion.
Production conversation fast lane for routine social turns.
Startup model warmup/readiness barrier with CUDA/Vulkan diagnostics.
Reflex action path skips cold executive retrieval and background memory initialization.
Local media intent no longer turns mood text into an implicit web/YouTube search.
PID-aware app launch verification and built-in executable resolution without where.exe.
Behavior harness covers false success, offline resume, stale/unknown, compound and second-run paths.
